title: NO FREE LOOKS
question: Do SQ-03F hotspot network-position differences persist when each hotspot is matched to a structurally similar control with the same frozen context count?

hotspots.primary: SQ-03F top 1% by max integrated S
hotspots.secondary: SQ-03F top 1% by max integrated C

matching.hotspot_order: reuse SQ-03F dynamic-score DESC, edge_id ASC
matching.control_choice: within exact context_count and exact structural bins, minimize absolute total_weight difference; then absolute abs_weight_difference difference; then edge_id ASC
matching.failure_rule: if no unused control exists under the exact three-way match, record unmatched; do not relax context_count or either structural bin

features.context_count: matching variable only; not an outcome in SQ-03F.1

interpretation_rule: A SQ-03F network-position pattern is considered to survive the context-count control only descriptively if it retains the same direction under SQ-03F.1; no new significance threshold is introduced.
claim_boundary: SQ-03F.1 may describe whether SQ-03F local network-position differences remain after exact matching on represented intervention context count and frozen structural bins. It does not establish a biological sex mechanism, biological population effect, organism-level behavior, or causal importance outside the MoscaQuant model.
